biography.plain_text: Sheikh Hamdan bin Rashid Al Maktoum was an Emirati royal and son of Dubai ruler Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum. He served as the United Arab Emirates' first finance minister from federation in 1971 until his death in 2021. He later became deputy ruler of Dubai while retaining his federal portfolio.

long_biography.plain_text:
Sheikh Hamdan bin Rashid Al Maktoum made thoroughbred racing one of his defining pursuits as Shadwell's founder. Over four decades, he developed breeding operations in Britain, Ireland and the United States and became Britain's champion Flat owner nine times. His horses won the Derby twice, establishing a durable international breeding record.

Hamdan's involvement extended beyond thoroughbreds. He promoted Arabian racing through races and sponsorship, while Shadwell's international farms linked breeding decisions across different markets. The organisation continued after his death under his daughter, Sheikha Hissa, retaining the bloodlines and breeding programme he assembled.
